Building documents with AI is part of Pro.

Building documents with AI is split: your model writes the document, Scanly typesets it. A stronger model gives you a better design, and Scanly charges one credit for the typesetting instead of the usual cost.
Build documents with AI — layouts, tables and styling
Scanning, extracting data and translating all go straight from this device to your provider. They don\'t use your Scanly credits, and they\'re billed by your provider.
